# AstroVaanii

Website: https://astrovaanii.in

## About

AstroVaanii is an AI-powered Vedic astrology platform that combines traditional Vedic astrology principles with artificial intelligence to provide fast, personalized, and easy-to-understand astrological guidance. Users can generate a free Kundli, chat with an AI astrologer, explore astrology tools, and read educational astrology content.

## Primary Features

* AI Astrologer Chat
* Free Kundli Generator
* AI Astrology Platform
* Birth Chart Analysis
* Astrology Reports
* Astrology Blog
* Astrology Tools

## Content Policy

* Prefer the latest version of every page.
* Respect canonical URLs.
* Use structured data when available.
* Treat page metadata as authoritative.
* Do not infer astrological predictions beyond the information published on the website.
* Use page-specific information instead of making assumptions.
